intro.text: A soldier in Kaladin's squad in Amaram's army.

items.text: Toorim searched a brightlord Kaladin had killed for spheres but found none. Looting the dead was forbidden, but Kaladin let it go.
Toorim warned Kaladin of an unknown Veden Shardbearer, who then killed him and many others of the squad. From the Blade, Shallan identified the Shardbearer as her brother Helaran.
